interpretation.purpose: Diagnose unexpectedly weak knowledge-only outputs before adapting the model. This is not fresh evaluation or method validation.
interpretation.comparisons: First reproduce 48-token prefixes for eight prior rows in FP16. Compare FP16 one-device versus two-device to control dispatch, then FP16 versus FP32 with the same explicit device map. Compare two knowledge questions with/without system instructions within each precision.
interpretation.numerical: Save full first-token vectors, actual dtype, config and canonical FP16 weight fingerprint. FP32 converted values must equal previous FP16 base. Report first-token differences and full outputs, not an invented accuracy threshold.
interpretation.scope: 24 of the 36 generations are exposed task rows; six are user-only prompt controls and six are generic sanity controls. No adaptation, no broad precision/capability claim.
interpretation.prediction: Unknown cause: precision/dispatch, system instruction, truncation or checkpoint behavior. A 96-token continuation may reveal an answer after a cutoff but cannot undo an earlier false assertion.
interpretation.bounds: One GPU job, 2100-second worker cap and 3600-second provider cap; abort if two CUDA devices are unavailable.
